convention_question.status: OPEN — THE PROTOCOL DOES NOT DISAMBIGUATE A DIRECTED ROW FROM AN UNDIRECTED RELATION
convention_question.finding: On 2074 the two readings of the same word separate: directed rows give ceilings 64-79 and clear the floor on 6 of 6 seeds; undirected relations give 35-51 (any orientation) or 31-38 (both orientations) and clear it on 0 of 6. The orientations are not copies — A availability differs across orientations on 15-28 of 64 relations per seed — so the choice changes both the denominator and how many independent observations stand behind it. On 2063 the same split already exists: directed rows clear the floor on 4 of 6 seeds (70/59/69/58/72/72) and both relation readings clear it on none (31-46 and 28-42).
